id: \bI've never been to the top. I hope I will one day.
en: \bI've never been to the top. I hope I will one day.
it: \bNon sono mai arrivato in cima. Spero di farcela un giorno.

id: \rMistralton Tower welcomes you. Climb to the top to get your wish.
en: \rMistralton Tower welcomes you. Climb to the top to get your wish.
it: \rLa Torre Ponentopoli ti dà il benvenuto. Sali fino in cima per esaudire il tuo desiderio.

id: \rTrainers will challenge each other in the Tower. It's part of the process to get to the top.
en: \rTrainers will challenge each other in the Tower. It's part of the process to get to the top.
it: \rGli Allenatori si sfidano a vicenda nella Torre. Fa parte del percorso per arrivare in cima.

id: \rMake a wish at the top. You can do it.
en: \rMake a wish at the top. You can do it.
it: \rEsprimi un desiderio in cima. Ce la puoi fare.
